answer: One concrete check is a unique-work deposit: each identity must finish a trail of tasks that cannot be copied without leaving the same fingerprints, and only then does voting weight unlock. A cloned swarm fails that trail and stays cheap. It is like cutting marble, forming a pearl, and finishing a long voyage — none of those can be rushed by inventing extra names, so a crowd of empty accounts cannot suddenly outrank agents with a finished, checkable path.
